Number of ticks to wait between confirmed Packet teleport steps. Direct and AStar use this value directly; NetworkOptimized treats it as an additional minimum for outbound and return travel.

Direct requires a collision-free straight route to the target and back. AStar falls back to a collision-free detour when that route is blocked. NetworkOptimized adds TPS-, ping-, and setback-aware pacing for unstable servers.

Collision-aware Packet routing that uses pathfinding only when the direct route is blocked. Before moving, it validates the complete round trip, keeps the selected target locked, and confirms each teleport step; the return follows the exact reverse path.
Maximum search cost AStar may spend while finding a collision-free detour.
Allows diagonal AStar path nodes when the full movement corridor is collision-free.
Shortens the grid path by connecting non-adjacent waypoints when the player's full hitbox can travel between them without collision.

Network-aware Packet routing for unstable or low-TPS servers. It freezes a conservative speed and cadence budget for each complete round trip, sends terminal movements as individually paced steps, widens damage correlation for ping, and slows future attempts after a confirmed setback. Each clean round trip removes one setback penalty.
Hard speed cap for NetworkOptimized routes. It also caps Packet Step Distance when the shared Target Speed or Step Distance is higher.
Minimum ticks between confirmed movement packets. Low server TPS and setback penalties may increase this delay for the next complete route.

Requirements: Optional CheckKillaura / CheckAutoClicker gates; CanBeSeen filters line-of-sight targets.

Warning: Visible hopping near targets; useless on servers that ignore client jump spoofing.
liquidbounce.module.criticals.mode.blink:
Target: Generic — packet-delay crit timing.

Mechanism: While an enemy is within Range and you are not yet crit-ready, queues outgoing move packets via Blink until the random Delay (ms) elapses, then releases them so fallDistance registers before the attack.

Triggers: BlinkPacketEvent on outgoing traffic when enemyInRange and not wouldDoCriticalHit.

Requirements: Enemy within configured range; attack and interact packets are passed through immediately.

Warning: Conflicts with other blink/lag modules; delayed movement is visible to observers and may desync.
liquidbounce.module.criticals.mode.timer:
Target: Generic — timer slowdown for crit window.

Mechanism: When an enemy is within Range and wouldDoCriticalHit(ignoreSprint=true), requests reduced game timer speed (Speed setting) with IMPORTANT priority until the tick ends.

Triggers: Every GameTick while conditions are met.

Requirements: Enemy in range and crit state achievable.

Warning: Timer manipulation flags on most anti-cheats; may fight other modules using timer priority.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.grimSpectat:
Target: GrimAC and legacy Intave.
Delays incoming transaction (ping) packets while you still have fly abilities after a bedwars-style respawn, so the server believes you never received the packet that removes flight. Movement checks are treated as lag.
Enable only during respawn while fly abilities are active. After 20 ticks, a position packet while flying starts the delay; incoming pings are queued and answered with a dummy pong to avoid timeout (requires client 1.17+).
Warning: On Grim this also disables combat tracking for other players. Leaving spectator or receiving a setback teleports you back and triggers a flag message — disable immediately. Does not auto-disable other disablers when flagged.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.vulcanScaff:
Target: Vulcan AntiCheat (tested on eu.loyisa.cn and anticheat-test.com).
Every tick sends start-sprint and stop-sprint packets so Vulcan treats sprint state as spam and skips direction-sprint checks. Periodically sends stop-sneaking packets to clear Vulcan's "sneaked in the last 15 ticks" scaffold memory, bypassing limit checks.
Runs while you are on solid ground, not in liquids, not flying, and alive. Extra unsneak packets fire during telly bridging (~70% chance every 9 ticks), low-hop towering (~20% on ground), and normal bridging (every 9 ticks on ground).
Use together with Scaffold. Sprint spam is visible in packet logs and only helps on Vulcan-backed servers.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.vulcanRipti:
Target: Vulcan movement checks (circa Vulcan 2.7.5, February 2023).
Exploits Vulcan's Riptide exception by using an off-hand trident and periodically sending use-item plus release-use-item packets, which disables movement validation while active.
Requires a Riptide-enchanted trident in your off-hand; the toggle auto-disables with an error if the item is missing. Sends packets every 20 ticks once the requirement is met.
Warning: Patched in newer Vulcan builds. Using it on updated servers will not bypass checks and may flag you.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.aAC1.9.10.e:
Target: Advanced AntiCheat (AAC) 1.9.10.
On every outgoing position packet, injects a player-input packet with jump pressed and nudges the packet Y coordinate by 7.0E-9, confusing AAC movement validation.
Triggers on each ServerboundMovePlayerPacket while enabled. No extra modules or items are required.
Only relevant on very old AAC 1.9.10 servers. Modern anti-cheats ignore this technique and it may cause flags elsewhere.
Target: Spigot/Bukkit chat anti-spam plugins.
Prepends a configurable prefix (default "/skill") to every chat message you send. Bukkit only checks whether the message starts with an exclusion entry, not whether it is a real command, so spam counters are bypassed.
Active whenever this toggle is on and Disabler is enabled; every outgoing chat line is modified via the chat mixin.
Ensure the prefix matches a command on the server's spam exclusion list (default "/skill"). All messages will visibly include the prefix.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.vanillaSpee:
Target: Vanilla and anti-cheats with weak movement packet validation.
Splits each movement step into multiple position packets sent from your previous coordinates, inflating packet count relative to distance traveled to bypass speed limits.
Fires on pre-movement network ticks when horizontal travel exceeds DistancePerPacket (1–20 blocks, default 10). Packet type can be on-ground-only or position-and-on-ground.
Skips one tick after world changes and after incoming position reset packets. Rotating move packets are not supported per implementation notes.
Target: Legacy anti-cheats such as NoCheatPlus.
If a block place, interact, attack, or spectator action packet would be sent without a preceding arm-swing packet, sends the swing first and cancels the duplicate swing that follows.
Only affects outgoing packets on clients newer than 1.8; the fix is skipped on 1.8 and below where order is already correct.
Warning: Do not use on modern anti-cheats — reordering swings can cause NoSwing or timing flags. Intended solely for outdated servers that require swing-before-action ordering.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.liveOverflo:
Target: LiveOverflow's custom server anti-cheat.
Rounds X and Z coordinates in outgoing move packets to two decimal places before they are sent, matching the server's expected precision and avoiding false movement flags.
Runs on every ServerboundMovePlayerPacket while enabled.
Built specifically for LiveOverflow's server; behavior on other networks is untested and unlikely to help.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.minelandFly:
Target: Mineland Network fly checks.
Cancels outgoing pong (transaction) responses while the Fly module is enabled, continuing a double-respawn trick that grants vanilla-style flight on Mineland.
Requires Fly to be enabled and the respawn workflow described in the module comments (respawn twice, cancel transactions the second time).
Warning: The server stops sending entity updates to you, so you cannot reliably see or attack players. Useful for fast bed breaks or long-distance travel only.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.verusCombat:
Target: Verus combat transaction checks (may affect other ACs with weak transaction handling).
Rewrites incoming transaction ping IDs to alternate between -1 and 1, breaking Verus timing that tracks the last accepted transaction and disabling combat checks tied to it.
With WaitUntilCombat enabled (default), nothing happens until you attack an entity; combat state resets on world change. Always waits until tick 20 after join.
Disable WaitUntilCombat to start immediately. May desync ping timing and flag on servers with strict transaction validation.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.verusExperi:
Target: Verus (originally tuned for BlocksMC) via source-informed exemptions.
Queues outgoing keep-alive, pong, and movement packets through Blink after configurable delays (WorldChangeWait, DelayBeginTime, DelayEndTime). Optionally duplicates scaffold place packets (Scaffold14E) with block-center hit results to satisfy Verus check 14E.
After a world change, waits WorldChangeWait ms before blinking. Keep-alive IDs are rewritten to maintain ping spoof continuity. Nested NoAction and VoidTP toggles add sprint suppression and void-teleport exploits.
Experimental: expect lag, rubber-banding, or bans on updated Verus builds. Tune delay values to your ping. Only enable sub-features you understand.

Target: Verus in-game action checks (sub-feature of VerusExperimental).
Cancels outgoing START_SPRINTING and STOP_SPRINTING entity-action packets so Verus never sees sprint state changes. The Sprinting sub-option (default on) controls whether sprint actions are blocked.
Requires VerusExperimental and Disabler to be enabled. Only affects sprint command packets; other entity actions pass through.
Suppressing sprint packets can break legitimate sprint behavior and may conflict with modules that rely on sprint toggling.

Target: Verus teleport/setback handling (sub-feature of VerusExperimental).
On outgoing move packets, silently sends a fake teleport to Y=-48, returns to your previous position, then restores your real position, and cancels the next two incoming position-reset packets while accepting the teleport ID.
Fires when above void level, VoidTPDelay ms have passed since the last attempt, and optionally only while on ground (WaitForGround, default on). Waits until tick 20 after join.
Experimental void spoof: prints debug chat messages, can desync position, and may flag or rubber-band on active Verus servers.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.verusScaffo:
Target: Verus scaffold type-G checks (tested on eu.loyisa.cn and anticheat-test.com).
Alters how block-hit results are written in outgoing use-item-on-block packets — serializing block position and a custom direction index instead of the standard hit result — so Verus scaffold validation accepts placements it would otherwise reject.
Active whenever this toggle is running; implementation lives in a packet write mixin, not in tick logic.
Packet-level exploit only for Verus scaffold-G. Wrong server or AC version will not bypass and may cause invalid-placement flags.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.hypixel.ext:
Target: Hypixel motion checks.
After respawn, forces a jump on the next movement input, then after 10 air ticks zeroes velocity and adds a small X offset (0.095) every other tick to disrupt setback validation.
Starts on ClientboundRespawnPacket (sets jump flag). Stops after 20 incoming position reset packets. NotWithStar (default on) skips the bypass while any hotbar slot holds a nether star.
Hypixel-specific community bypass — behavior changes with server patches. Using on other networks is untested.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.hypixelScaf:
Target: Hypixel scaffold checks.
When Scaffold is enabled, performs a tiny ground jump (Y velocity 0.01), then after landing alternates small Y offsets (0.03 or 1.0E-5) on ground move packets to evade scaffold motion validation.
Requires Scaffold to be active. Initialization happens on first ground tick; bypass applies only after the jump completes and you touch ground again. Resets while towering.
Only affects Hypixel-style scaffold detection tied to ground Y patterns. Useless without Scaffold and may flag if towering resets are missed.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.miniblox.ex:
Target: Miniblox servers.
Sends legacy 1.8-style player input packets every tick with your current sideways/forward movement, jump, and sneak state so Miniblox movement validation accepts client input.
Requires ViaFabricPlus connected on protocol 1.8.x. If the protocol check fails, shows an error and disables the entire Disabler module.
Will not work on native 1.21 clients without ViaFabricPlus 1.8 protocol translation.
liquidbounce.module.disabler.cubecraft.e:
Target: Cubecraft Network (full ping-spoof disabler, verified June 2026).
Queues incoming keep-alive and ping packets via Blink while letting position packets through, then releases them after a play-time-based delay (5 s before tick 150, 10 s before tick 300, then 20 s) to desynchronize anti-cheat transaction timing.
Multiplayer only — auto-disables in singleplayer. Clears queued incoming packets on world change and flushes on disable.
Do not use alongside FakeLag or Backtrack; conflicting blink modules break the bypass. Expect temporary desync while packets are held.
liquidbounce.module.elytraFly.mode.stati:
Target: Generic — hover-style elytra control.

Mechanism: Zeroes horizontal movement when idle; applies Speed group strafe/vertical on input. Optional Glide adds sink/drift when not moving. DurabilityExploitNotWhileNoMove can block durability spam while stationary.

Triggers: PlayerMoveEvent each tick while fall-flying; module tick handles start/stop and durability exploit.

Requirements: Elytra equipped; Speed subgroup optional.

Warning: Static hover with zero motion may trigger "flying not enabled" kicks without Glide.
liquidbounce.module.elytraFly.mode.vanil:
Target: Generic — direct velocity elytra fly.

Mechanism: Applies horizontal strafe from Speed settings when moving; jump/sneak adjust vertical velocity each tick.

Triggers: onTick while fall-flying and Speed enabled.

Requirements: Elytra; module Speed subgroup for rates.

Warning: Blatant on anti-cheat servers; consumes normal elytra physics limits.
liquidbounce.module.elytraFly.mode.boost:
Target: Generic — physics-based elytra boost.

Mechanism: Accelerates along look vector with dive/pull-up mechanics, ground proximity penalty, auto-boost on negative pitch, and vertical control on jump/sneak.

Triggers: onTick + PlayerMoveEvent while fall-flying.

Requirements: Tune Speed, BoostSpeed, Acceleration, DiveMechanics, and SmartGroundBehavior.

Warning: High acceleration and dive boosts flag simulation ACs; near-ground penalty reduces speed intentionally.
liquidbounce.module.elytraFly.mode.firew:
Target: Generic — automated firework boosting.

Mechanism: Schedules inventory actions to use firework rockets from hotbar/offhand/inventory on a Cooldown tick range when no active rocket entity exists.

Triggers: ScheduleInventoryActionEvent when shouldUseFirework passes (fall-flying, not using item, no attached rocket).

Requirements: Fireworks in searched slots; ConsiderInventory for full inv swaps.

Warning: Consumes rockets; inventory swaps visible to AC; cooldown too low may spam use packets.
liquidbounce.module.elytraFly.mode.pitch:
Target: Generic — pitch-40 infinite elytra travel technique.

Mechanism: Oscillates pitch between -40 and +40 based on speed vs MinSpeed/MaxSpeed thresholds and altitude vs MaxHeight; sets player xRot directly.

Triggers: onTick while fall-flying.

Requirements: Recommended altitude >= MaxHeight (chat warns if too low on enable).

Warning: Forces camera pitch — disorienting; speed and height thresholds need tuning per server TPS.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.vanilla.ext:
Target: Generic — bypasses basic vanilla fly checks only.

Mechanism: Sets horizontal and vertical deltaMovement from BaseSpeed or SprintSpeed settings, with optional Glide sink rate. BypassVanillaCheck briefly dips Y every 40 ticks to reset vanilla fall tracking.

Triggers: Every tick while Fly is enabled and this mode is selected.

Requirements: None.

Warning: Detected by virtually all server anti-cheats; use only on servers without movement checks.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.packet.exte:
Target: Experimental server-dependent packet movement.

Mechanism: Keeps Vanilla Fly's physical movement, collisions, Glide, anti-kick, Elytra correction, sneak suppression, and optional NoFall. Safe splits the resolved movement into budgeted position packets; Primed sends automatically planned stationary packets before Minecraft's ordinary final movement packet.

Triggers: A complete packet plan is calculated after collisions and before the physical move is applied.

Requirements: Select Safe or Primed and keep MaxPackets within the server's tolerance.

Warning: Both Safe and Primed remain server-dependent exploits. Local packet admission does not guarantee that a live server will accept either strategy.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.packet.spee: Safe segments physical movement; Primed sends automatically counted stationary packets. Both strategies are server-dependent.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.packet.prim: Packet shape used for Primed's stationary packets. It does not change the ordinary Vanilla-generated endpoint packet.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.creative.ex:
Target: Generic — emulates creative-mode flight in survival.

Mechanism: Grants mayfly, forces flying state, and scales flyingSpeed from Speed or SprintSpeed. BypassVanillaCheck sends position packets downward when midair above blocks. MaxVelocity caps total motion.

Triggers: Every tick while enabled; packet spoofing when bypass conditions are met.

Requirements: None.

Warning: Extremely blatant on anti-cheat servers. Disabling restores normal survival abilities.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.jetpack.ext:
Target: Generic — simple vertical boost fly.

Mechanism: While jump is held, adds +0.15 to Y velocity and multiplies horizontal motion by 1.1 each game tick.

Triggers: On jump key press during GameTick while Fly is active.

Requirements: None.

Warning: No anti-cheat bypass; flags easily on protected servers.
Target: Generic — pearl teleport desync fly.

Mechanism: Silently throws an ender pearl at high pitch, then enables strafe fly after accepting the pearl teleport packet when blocks exist below.

Triggers: On enable when an ender pearl is in hotbar or offhand; fly phase starts after ServerboundAcceptTeleportationPacket.

Requirements: At least one ender pearl; blocks within ~5 blocks below for setback detection.

Warning: Consumes pearls; fails in void or open sky. Rotations are forced before throw.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.airWalk.ext:
Target: Generic — ground-spoof and fake-block fly (NCP-style).

Mechanism: Spoofs onGround in outgoing move packets, renders solid block shapes below the player (except liquids), and cancels jump events.

Triggers: Continuously while Fly is enabled with this mode.

Requirements: OnGround packet spoof can be toggled.

Warning: Ground and phase checks on modern anti-cheats will flag this quickly.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.explosion.e:
Target: Generic — explosion knockback fly.

Mechanism: Intercepts velocity and explosion knockback packets, zeroes horizontal knockback, multiplies vertical by the Vertical setting, then applies decaying horizontal strafe.

Triggers: When ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket or ClientboundExplodePacket affects the player.

Requirements: Must take explosion or velocity-based damage first; chat warns on enable.

Warning: Useless without a nearby explosion source; strafe decays until you land.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.fireball.ex:
Target: Generic — fire-charge knockback launch.

Mechanism: Selects Technique (Legit or Custom) and Trigger (Instant or OnEdge), silently uses a fire charge from hotbar/offhand, then disables Fly after the throw sequence.

Triggers: Instant sets trigger immediately; OnEdge fires when walking off a block edge. Technique controls jump, rotation, sprint, and timing.

Requirements: Fire charge in hotbar or offhand.

Warning: Consumes fire charges; module auto-disables after throw. Legit technique stops movement while aiming.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.vulcan277.e:
Target: Vulcan 2.7.7 (tested on anticheat-test.com).

Mechanism: While falling (fallDistance > 0.1), alternates Y motion between -0.155 and -0.1 every other tick to slow descent.

Triggers: Every tick when fall distance exceeds 0.1.

Requirements: Must be in a falling state.

Warning: Glide-only bypass; does not provide free horizontal flight. Effectiveness depends on Vulcan version.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.vulcan286-1:
Target: Vulcan 2.8.6 on 1.13+ servers (tested on localhost).

Mechanism: Ghost-block desync — cancels the first ClientboundPlayerPositionPacket setback, renders a fake block below you, and empties other block shapes until you press use. Sends an initial PosRot packet on enable to desync. On disable or use key, applies the stored setback to your moved position.

Triggers: Enable starts ghost mode; press use (right-click) to commit position and enter wait state.

Requirements: 1.13+ server-side; read in-game chat instructions on enable.

Warning: Second setback packet auto-disables Fly. Walking off ledges while not waiting triggers ghost-block checks.

Target: Vulcan 2.8.6 on 1.8 servers (tested on eu.loyisa.cn, anticheat-test.com).

Mechanism: Cancels ClientboundPlayerPositionPacket setbacks to stay desynced, renders fake ground below, and applies Timer speed while desynced (flags > 1). AutoDisable turns off Fly when position packets change after the second flag.

Triggers: Any position setback starts desync; timer runs after multiple flags. Ghost-block check fires when walking off a ledge.

Requirements: 1.8 server-side; Timer up to 2.5x.

Warning: 1.9+ servers block timer during desync. Read chat message on enable for landing instructions.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.vulcan286-T:
Target: Vulcan 2.8.6 on 1.8 servers (tested on eu.loyisa.cn, anticheat-test.com).

Mechanism: Spoofs onGround false and jumps three times to build fall distance, takes fall damage for leniency, flags with a Pos packet, then teleports ~9 blocks forward up to three times via position packets.

Triggers: Automatically on enable — runs the full jump-damage-teleport sequence.

Requirements: 1.8 server-side; open space above head for triple jump; cooldown between uses to avoid flags.

Warning: Limited to three teleports before Vulcan flags. Horizontal movement is locked during jumping. Module auto-disables when done.
Target: Grim 2.3.59 (tested on eu.loyisa.cn).

Mechanism: Jumps on enable, uses low Timer during early ticks, then offsets player position +1152 X/Z during network movement PRE and restores it POST to exploit unloaded-chunk setback leniency while jumping.

Triggers: Tick 0 jump; timer ticks 1–5; position offset from tick 2 onward until Toggle limit (0 = unlimited).

Requirements: Works best on low ping; Toggle setting can auto-disable after N ticks.

Warning: Slow and unreliable on high ping. Grim may patch this jump-only leniency.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.grim2373Jan:
Target: Grim 2.3.73-b7a719d (January 15, 2026 build; tested on test.ccbluex.net).

Mechanism: Queues incoming ping packets after velocity or when AutoLagInAir fires at the configured air tick, then sends START_FALL_FLYING and flushes on the next position packet.

Triggers: AutoLagInAir after AirTick ticks in air, or immediately on ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket for the player.

Requirements: Must be airborne (or receive velocity) for the lag phase to start.

Warning: Packet queue timing is sensitive; wrong server Grim version may not grant elytra fly leniency.
Target: Spartan phase 524 (tested on minecraft.vagdedes.com).

Mechanism: Overrides PlayerMoveEvent movement to a fixed 0.28 horizontal speed along view yaw with zero vertical change.

Triggers: Every movement event while Fly is enabled.

Requirements: None.

Warning: Stable constant motion reduces Spartan flags but limits control; still detectable on other anti-cheats.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.sentinel20t:
Target: Sentinel 20.04.2024 on Cubecraft (SkyWars).

Mechanism: Verus-style damage boost — sends spoofed Pos packets to self-damage, then strafe-flies on hurtTime with horizontal/vertical speed. Reboosts every ReboostTicks. Optional Nostalgia teleports up 0.42 on first hurt.

Triggers: Periodic boost packets; fly motion starts when hurtTime > 0 after boost.

Requirements: PingSpoof auto-enabled on enable; Speed module auto-disabled. Wait for round start before boosting.

Warning: Damage-abuse only — wait seconds after round start. BoostOnce or manual disable stops flight. Requires PingSpoof.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.sentinel27t:
Target: Sentinel 27.01.2024 on Cubecraft (SkyWars, EggWars).

Mechanism: While airborne, sets Y motion to glide down (0.2), jump up (0.42), or sneak down (-0.4), with random horizontal strafe in configured range every 6 ticks.

Triggers: Every 6 ticks when not on ground.

Requirements: Must leave the ground first; no disabler needed.

Warning: Does not work on ground. Tested flag-free on Cubecraft minigames; long distances on Sentinel10thMar-style modes may ban.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.sentinel10t:
Target: Sentinel 10.03.2024 on Cubecraft (SkyWars, EggWars).

Mechanism: Repeatedly applies upward velocity and horizontal strafe, then spoofs onGround true on the next outgoing move packet. Cancels jump input.

Triggers: Every Ticks interval while Fly is active.

Requirements: Must be enabled in air or after leaving ground.

Warning: Flying very large distances can auto-ban on Cubecraft. Height, Speed, and Ticks are configurable.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.sentinel26t:
Target: Sentinel 26.12.2025 on Cubecraft (Egg Wars).

Mechanism: Verus-style damage boost with physics-based Y spoof packets, Timer slowdown, and Blink packet queue while flying after hurt. Strafe fly on hurtTime with jump/sneak vertical control.

Triggers: boost() on ground at enable; fly after hurtTime > 0; auto-disables after Ticks or if not on ground when sequence starts.

Requirements: Must start on ground; Speed module auto-disabled. Wait for round start (chat warning).

Warning: Ticks above 25 may silent-flag. Blink queues packets until disable flushes them. Nostalgia optional teleport on first hurt.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.cubecraftDa:
Target: CubeCraft damage and arrow boost movement.

Trigger: Records enable height and attempts self-damage after dropping below it. Real server-confirmed damage, including an arrow hit, can also start the boost directly.

DamageMethod: Verus sends the short 3.25-block sequence; Sentinel sends the longer gravity arc.

FakeStrafe: Keeps the client camera unchanged while offsetting server-facing yaw. Incoming knockback is redirected toward the client look direction while preserving stronger real arrow velocity.

Warning: Requires the server to confirm damage; packet self-damage may be patched and cannot guarantee bypass safety.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.verusB3896D:
Target: Verus b3896 (tested on eu.loyisa.cn).

Mechanism: Sends four Pos packets on enable to self-damage (~3.25 block spoof), then applies 9.95 strafe with zero Y and 0.1x Timer for up to 20 ticks after hurtTime.

Triggers: Damage boost on enable; fly phase when hurtTime > 0.

Requirements: Must receive damage within 20 ticks or Fly disables with "Failed to self-damage".

Warning: Causes ~2 Verus flags for damage. Auto-disables after 20 fly ticks or on failure.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.verusB3896F:
Target: Verus b3896 flat fly (tested on anticheat-test; class targets b3869+).

Mechanism: Spoofs onGround on all move packets, renders solid blocks below player, cancels jumps, runs Timer at configured speed, and queues all outgoing packets via Blink.

Triggers: Continuously while enabled.

Requirements: 1.9+ server recommended; disable sends a Pos packet 0.5 below to land.

Warning: Can rarely flag once. Blink delays movement packets — may conflict with other lag modules.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.ncpClip.ext:
Target: NCP / BlocksMC (second AC may need PingSpoof).

Mechanism: Waits for vertical collision, optional clip Pos packets, optional Blink lag, jump boost with strafe entry speed, then timer strafe until ground or MaximumDistance. Optional fall-damage via NCP setback Y spoof.

Triggers: Sequence starts on enable; optional FallDamage waits for ClientboundDamageEventPacket.

Requirements: Start near a ceiling or wall for clip phase; configure Speed, Timer, Clipping, and Blink.

Warning: Exceeding MaximumDistance disables Fly. FallDamage deals ~3 HP. PingSpoof may be required on dual-AC servers.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.hypixel.ext:
Target: Hypixel Watchdog/NCP (21.01.25 build).

Mechanism: Waits for ClientboundExplodePacket (fireball/TNT knockback), then runs a timed Y and strafe boost sequence with Timer and constant strafe on PlayerMoveEvent until landing.

Triggers: Only after explosion knockback packet is received.

Requirements: Must be hit by an explosion (e.g. fireball) while Fly is enabled.

Warning: Short burst fly only — auto-disables on ground contact. Timer and motion values are tuned for Hypixel.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.hypixelFlat:
Target: Hypixel Watchdog/NCP (21.01.25 build).

Mechanism: After explosion knockback, applies initial strafe then configured fly Speed with tiny randomized Y lift and Timer for up to 30 ticks.

Triggers: ClientboundExplodePacket sets isFlying; velocity handler runs the flat glide phase.

Requirements: Explosion knockback while Fly is enabled.

Warning: Stops applying boosts after 30 ticks; auto-disables on ground. Less vertical than Hypixel mode.
liquidbounce.module.fly.mode.hycraftDama:
Target: Hycraft / Polar (15.05.2024; tested on mc.hycraft.us Bedwars/Skywars).

Mechanism: Blinks incoming damage and velocity packets — on damage, queues 40 ticks of ping packets before releasing velocity and ending on the next ping when timer expires.

Triggers: ClientboundDamageEventPacket on player starts sequence; velocity packet while damageTaken enables release phase.

Requirements: Must take damage while Fly is active; Polar-specific timing.

Warning: Hycraft-only after Polar updates; other servers may flag or ignore. Fly auto-disables after release flush.
liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.queue.ex:
Target: Generic — network lag freeze.

Mechanism: Cancels PlayerTickEvent (timer=0) and queues outgoing (configurable Origin) packets via Blink while frozen.

Triggers: Continuous while enabled; BalanceWarp replays missed ticks on disable.

Requirements: Select TransferOrigin for queued packets.

Warning: Incoming position packets reset balance and may DisableOnFlag; expect desync while queued.
liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.cancel.e:
Target: Generic — packet blackhole.

Mechanism: Cancels PlayerTickEvent and drops outgoing/incoming packets matching selected Origin.

Triggers: PacketEvent for configured origins while enabled.

Requirements: Origin multi-select.

Warning: Hard disconnect risk if you cancel incoming keep-alives; DisableOnFlag recommended.
liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.stationa:
Target: Grim BadPacketsR and Matrix7 timer checks.

Mechanism: Cancels player tick but rewrites interact/attack/use packets with unique rotation offsets; optional CancelC0B drops pong packets.

Triggers: PacketEvent on use/attack/interact/pong while frozen.

Requirements: CancelC0B (default on) for Grim pong bypass.

Warning: Interaction packets still sent with offsets — may look suspicious; not a full blink.
liquidbounce.module.highJump.mode.vanill:
Target: Generic — no anti-cheat bypass.

Mechanism: Overrides PlayerJumpEvent motion with the module Motion setting.

Triggers: Every jump while HighJump is enabled.

Requirements: None.

Warning: Higher Motion values flag any server with jump-height checks.
liquidbounce.module.highJump.mode.vulcan:
Target: Vulcan 2.7.5 (tested on eu.loyisa.cn, eu.anticheat-test.com).

Mechanism: Sets jump motion, waits 100 ticks, zeroes Y velocity, then optional Glide applies periodic -0.155/-0.1 Y while falling.

Triggers: Jump event for initial boost; tick handler for glide phase when enabled.

Requirements: Glide toggle for slow-fall phase.

Warning: Author notes it still flags somewhat; Vulcan-version dependent.
liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.behavi:

liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.sprint:

liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.sneakC:

liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.vani:

liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.noCh:

liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.veru:

Mechanism: Solid water collision shapes plus toggling onGround true/false on outgoing move packets while standing on water.

Triggers: Outgoing ServerboundMovePlayerPacket when standingOnWater and safety checks pass.

Requirements: Same surface detection as other LiquidWalk modes.

Warning: Verus-version specific; alternating ground spoof may flag updated Verus.
liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.vulc:

Mechanism: While inside water or bubble columns, applies upward Motion and requests 1.125x Timer for one tick — acts as water speed + mini high jump.

Triggers: Tick handler when isInsideWaterOrBubbleColumn (not lava).

Requirements: Must be in water column; resets timer on exit.

liquidbounce.module.longJump.mode.noChea:

Mechanism: On the tick after a jump, multiplies horizontal deltaMovement by NCPBoost; stops XZ motion if you stop moving mid-air.

Triggers: Jump (manual or AutoJump) sets canBoost; boost applies next tick then clears.

Requirements: Must jump while moving; DisableAfterFinished optional auto-off.

liquidbounce.module.longJump.mode.vulcan:

Mechanism: On ground, spam jump-height position packets, then exploit setback/hurt timing to teleport upward and strafe; oscillates Y while active.

liquidbounce.module.longJump.mode.matrix:

Triggers: Ground exit with optional Delay air ticks; waits for ground between flag cycles.

liquidbounce.module.phase.mode.hypixel.e:

Requirements: Stand inside or against the block you want to pass through before toggling.

liquidbounce.module.phase.mode.intave.ex:

Mechanism: While holding attack with pitch above 80°, sends STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK on the block below, slowly lowers Y each tick, and while sneaking applies tiny horizontal nudges from movement keys.

liquidbounce.module.phase.mode.intaveBlo:

Requirements: Place a solid block into your own hitbox, usually by clicking the block below/next to you with this mode enabled.

liquidbounce.module.phase.mode.blink.ext:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.spoofGro:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.spoofLan:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.noGround:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.packet.e:

Triggers: Tick handler when filter conditions pass; FallDistance can reset fallDistance after send.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.packetJu:

Triggers: PlayerTickEvent (Falling) or outgoing ground packet (Landing) depending on Timing mode.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.mlg.exte:

Mechanism: Predicts impact with FallingPlayer, rotates and silently selects water bucket, scaffolding, cobweb, etc., places at landing block, optionally picks water back up after PickupSpan ms.

Triggers: RotationUpdateEvent and GameTickEvent when fallDistance > MinFallDistance and a valid item exists.

Requirements: MLG items in hotbar/offhand; disabled while Freeze runs; scaffolding needs ~3 ticks sneak after place.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.mount.ex:
Target: Generic — mount-based fall cancel.

Mechanism: While falling past MinFallDistance, interact with the nearest rideable entity (boats, minecarts, happy ghast, etc.) within SearchRange; optional AutoDismount sneaks off after a delay.

Triggers: Tick handler when descending, not on ground, not already passenger.

Requirements: Compatible rideable entity in range with passenger space.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.rettungs:
Target: GommeHD.net BedWars rescue items (Rettungsplatform / Rettungskapsel).

Mechanism: When falling with fallDistance > 2 and predicted path reaches void (no solid collision within 90 ticks), uses blaze rod or magma cream from hotbar/offhand, then waits 5 seconds.

Triggers: Tick handler on void fall prediction only — skips if a solid landing exists below.

Requirements: Blaze rod or magma cream in inventory; GommeHD-style rescue item behavior on server.

Warning: Useless on servers without those custom items; long cooldown after each use.
liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.spartan5:

Mechanism: When fallDistance > 2, sends ServerboundMovePlayerPacket.StatusOnly with onGround=true, waits one tick, repeats.

Triggers: Tick handler each fall cycle.

Requirements: None.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.vulcan27:
Target: Vulcan 2.7.7 (tested on eu.loyisa.cn).

Mechanism: On outgoing move packets when fallDistance > 7, sets onGround=true, zeroes fallDistance and vertical deltaMovement.

Triggers: PacketEvent on ServerboundMovePlayerPacket past threshold.

Requirements: None.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.vulcanTP:

Mechanism: For fallDistance 2.5–50 with ground below VoidLevel, spoofs onGround on the move packet and sets deltaMovement Y to -99.887575 with sneak input.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.verus.ex:

Mechanism: When fallDistance > 3.35 on an outgoing move packet, sets onGround=true and clears fallDistance and Y motion.

Triggers: PacketEvent on ServerboundMovePlayerPacket.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.forceJum:

Triggers: Outgoing move packet before landing; resets jumpTriggered on ground contact.

Requirements: Non-air block within BlockDistance under the player.

Warning: Does not help over void or when landing on entities; jump must connect before impact.
liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.cancel.e:

Mechanism: Cancels outgoing move packets once fallDistance passes the FallDistance threshold (Smart/Constant); on ClientboundPlayerPositionPacket setback sends onGround PosRot to the server position. Optional CancelSetbackPacket blocks the setback entirely.

Triggers: PacketEvent on move and position packets.

Requirements: None.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.blink.ex:

Requirements: waitUntilGround (from Velocity Modify) can force early flush; creative/flying skips blink.

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.hypixelP:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.blocksMC:

liquidbounce.module.noFall.mode.grim2371:

liquidbounce.module.noWeb.mode.strafe.ex:

liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.ins:

liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.str:

liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.acc:
Target: Generic — fall speed multiplier.

Mechanism: Multiplies vertical velocity by Factor while falling (only when deltaMovement.y < 0).

liquidbounce.module.safeWalk.mode.none.e:

liquidbounce.module.safeWalk.mode.safe.e:

liquidbounce.module.safeWalk.mode.onEdge:

liquidbounce.module.scaffold.tower.karhu: Uses timer speed boost while airborne after jumping, optionally pulling down once falling speed exceeds a trigger.
liquidbounce.module.scaffold.tower.motio: Re-applies upward motion when you exceed a trigger height after jumping, with configurable motion and horizontal slow.

liquidbounce.module.sneak.mode.switch.ex:

liquidbounce.module.step.mode.legit.exte:

liquidbounce.module.terrainSpeed.fastCli:

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.modify:

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.revers:

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.strafe:

Triggers: Velocity packet (optional OnlyFacing requires crosshair on enemy in range).

Requirements: None.

Warning: Delayed application assumes AC validates knockback late — fails on instant KB checks.
liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.jumpRe:

Mechanism: On hurtTime 9 while on ground and sprinting, sets jump input to reset knockback. Detects fall-damage velocity (0, negative Y, 0) to avoid jumping. Chance plus hit-count or tick-delay gates.

Requirements: Must be sprinting and on ground; sprint is required for KB modification on modern versions.

Warning: Missed timing or jumping on fall damage causes extra damage; not a full cancel.
liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.lag.ex:

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.reduce:

Triggers: Incoming damage then velocity; GameTick for attack reduce phase.

Requirements: LagRequireKillAura optionally requires KillAura target; sprint needed for backtrack branch.

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.hypixe:

Triggers: ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket for player; skipped when Fly module is enabled.

liquidbounce.module.velocity.mode.dexlan:

Triggers: AttackEntityEvent during hurt window.

Requirements: You must be attacking the attacker (or any entity) on the counted hit.

Warning: Dexland-specific; wrong hit cadence never reduces KB.

liquidbounce.module.packetMine.switch.al:
Target: Maximum break speed with constant tool sync.
Switches to the best hotbar tool as soon as mining starts and keeps syncing held item each progress tick (syncOnStart true).
Sends held-item packets frequently — fastest but noisiest for anti-cheat.
Use Never or OnStop on sensitive servers.
liquidbounce.module.packetMine.switch.po:
Target: Balanced mining with early tool selection.
Switches to the optimal tool right after START_DESTROY_BLOCK without syncing every tick like Always.
Middle ground between Always and OnStop for speed versus packet count.
Recommended default for many servers.
liquidbounce.module.packetMine.switch.on:
Target: Servers sensitive to mid-break slot changes.
Only switches tools when break progress reaches BreakDamage, immediately before STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK.
Minimizes held-item spam during progress accumulation.
Default Switch mode — works without ViaFabricPlus.
liquidbounce.module.packetMine.switch.ne:
Target: No silent hotbar switching during packet mine.
Never changes hotbar slot while mining; uses whatever tool you are already holding.
Slowest break speed but safest for strict inventory ACs.
Combine with AutoTool manually if needed.
liquidbounce.module.autoBuild.mode.porta:
Target: Nether portal frame automation.
On enable, finds the best nearby 4×5 portal site, places obsidian frame via BlockPlacer, confirms placements, then switches to flint and steel for ignition.
Disables if no valid position, obsidian, or flint and steel is found.
Blocked positions prevent placing inside the portal interior.
liquidbounce.module.autoBuild.mode.platf:
Target: Flat emergency platform under the player.
Each tick queues replaceable blocks in a Size×Size square below your feet using the configured block filter.
DisableOnYChange turns the module off if you move vertically.
Useful for void rescue or temporary standing room.
liquidbounce.module.autoFarm.autoWalk.ex:
Target: Large farms where manual walking is tedious.
Pathfinds toward dropped items, harvestable crops, or plantable soil using navigation filters when no in-range farm work exists.
MinimumDistance prevents micro-adjustments; respects parent Range settings.
Disable when fighting or in tight spaces — may walk off edges.
liquidbounce.module.autoFarm.autoPlant.e:
Target: Automatic crop replanting after harvest.
When a harvested block matches plantable soil in range, silently selects seeds from hotbar/offhand and replants.
SwapBackDelay controls how long the seed slot stays selected after placement.
Requires compatible seeds in inventory for the crop type.
liquidbounce.module.autoFarm.autoUseBone:
Target: Accelerated crop growth on supported plants.
When a crop can accept bone meal and UseDelay has elapsed, selects bone meal and applies it.
Runs after harvest/plant logic fails to find higher-priority targets.
Resets timer after each successful bonemeal use.
liquidbounce.module.surround.protect.ext:
Target: Crystal PvP hole maintenance while surrounded.
Monitors surround blocks for enemy break progress above MinDestroyProgress; targets blocking end crystals via placer destroyer and queues ExtraLayer replacements when enabled.
Runs at higher tick priority than crystal destroyer.
Requires BlockPlacer crystal destroyer for crystal clearing.

Target: Second-layer hole defense when outer blocks break.
When an outer surround block is mined, also places on the adjacent outward face and above it; Corners adds diagonal blocks for a fuller ring.
Triggered by enemy break progress or the AddExtraLayer keybind.
Consumes more obsidian — enable Corners only when needed.
Target: BedWars when you want to defend every bed in range.
Never marks a bed as yours — all beds matching search criteria are defended.
Default for quick setup without team detection.
May waste blocks on teammate beds.

Target: BedWars teams identified by bed color vs armor trim.
Treats beds matching your equipped armor slot colors as friendly (Loose uses closest dye match).
Only places defense blocks around beds that are not yours.
Requires correct armor equipped; wrong trim color skips your real bed.

Target: BedWars with fixed spawn/island positions.
Records your first large position reset packet as spawn and ignores beds within BedDistance of that point as your bed.
Useful when spawn correlates with your island bed location.
Resets tracking on disable; wrong spawn detection defends the wrong bed.

Target: Any BedWars map when automatic detection fails.
Track key saves the nearest bed within 16 blocks; Untrack clears it; bed part pairs are handled automatically.
Only defends beds matching the tracked position.
Untracks automatically on world change.
liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.ghostB:
Target: Void rescue without teleport packets.
When fall simulation predicts void danger, injects a full cube collision shape at the last safe rescue Y below you via BlockShapeEvent.
Does not send rescue packets itself — movement stays client-side until you land on the ghost block.
Fails if rescue position is null or exempt (creative, scaffold, etc.).
liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.flag.e:
Target: Servers tolerating small Y teleports.
When fallDistance exceeds FallDistance, adds Height to Y either silently on PRE movement tick or visibly with setPos.
Single bump per fall window when rescue() succeeds.
Silent mode is less visible but still modifies reported position.
Target: Void rescue via packet queue like Blink module.
While falling with a known safe prior position, queues outgoing movement packets; rescue flushes BlinkManager to snap back.
Exempt when Scaffold is running; disabled on super.isExempt conditions.
Conflicts with other blink users — coordinate with Blink module.
liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.immedia:
Target: Legacy servers using client tick rate for item use (1.8-style).
While eating/drinking consumables, applies Timer speed, waits Delay ticks, sends Speed move packets per tick, then releases use.
PacketType (default FULL) affects bypass on Grim-exempt 1.17+ clients on old servers.
StopInput clears movement while using if enabled.
liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.itemUse:
Target: Partial consume then fast finish.
Waits until ticksUsingItem reaches ConsumeTime, then spams move packets and releases — simulates finishing early without full Immediate spam from tick one.
Same Conditions and PacketType gates as Immediate.
Tune ConsumeTime to just before vanilla completion for your item.
liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.crossbo:
Target: Rapid crossbow loading/fire via inventory swaps.
While using a crossbow, periodically swap-click between main hand and offhand through container input packets to accelerate loading.
TickCooldown spaces swaps to avoid rate limits.
Crossbow-only — does not affect food or potions.
liquidbounce.module.smartEat.silentOffha:
Target: Mining/building while eating from offhand silently.
When main hand holds a tool and hunger/health thresholds match, silently selects the best food slot from Estimator and keeps it while eating.
RenderSlot optionally draws the food icon near the hotbar; respects NotDuringCombat and CombatPauseTime.
Only triggers on right-click use while holding tools.

Target: Visual feedback for silent offhand eating.
Draws the currently selected best food item and offhand slot sprite near the hotbar at configurable Offset.
Purely client-side overlay — does not affect packets.
Disable for minimal HUD clutter.
liquidbounce.module.smartEat.autoEat.ext:
Target: Hands-free hunger maintenance.
When food level drops below MinHunger, selects best food via Estimator and forces use key until above threshold.
Pauses during combat if NotDuringCombat; pauses KillAura via CombatPauseTime.
Resets silent slot on disable.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.totem.extend:
Target: Auto totem for crystal PvP and general survival.
Highest-priority offhand mode when Health thresholds predict lethal damage; SendDirectly bypasses inventory scheduler.
Separate SwitchDelay and SwitchBackDelay from global offhand settings.
Falls back to crystal when WhenNoTotems and no totems remain.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.totem.health:
Target: Smart totem timing based on health and predicted damage.
Compares health minus explosion, bed/anchor, fall, and entity damage predictions against HealthThreshold (or SafeHealth in holes).
SubtractCalculatedDamage makes totem equip more aggressive; MissingArmor equips when any armor slot is empty.
SwitchBack returns to previous item when safe if enabled.

Target: Crystal holes and burrow situations.
Uses lower SafeHealthThreshold instead of normal threshold when burrowed or in a 1×1 hole.
Allows keeping gapple/crystal longer when encased.
Disable if you want totem always at the main threshold.

Target: Lethal fall damage prediction.
Simulates falling up to 20 ticks and adds predicted fall damage to totem decision; IgnoreElytra skips while elytra flying.
Disabled while NoFall is running.
Can cause early totem swaps on long falls.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.crystal.exte:
Target: Crystal PvP offhand automation.
Equips end crystals when enabled; OnlyWhileCrystalAura gates on CrystalAura; WhenNoTotems fills offhand if totem mode finds no totems.
CrystalBind cycles static mode like other offhand binds.
High risk in non-crystal fights — crystal in offhand on pop is fatal.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.gapple.exten:
Target: Sword PvP with automatic gapple/offhand apple.
Equips golden or enchanted gapple when holding a sword and WhileHoldingSword conditions pass.
GappleBind toggles static priority mode.
OnlyWhileKillAura under WhileHoldingSword restricts to active KillAura.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.gapple.while:
Target: Gapple only during sword combat.
Sub-toggle of Gapple — when off, gapple mode never auto-equips from sword context.
OnlyWhileKillAura further requires KillAura running.
Use when you manually control gapple timing.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.strengthPoti:
Target: Strength potion offhand for sword fights.
Equips strength potions when enabled, not already buffed, and sword/hand conditions pass.
StrengthBind sets static mode priority.
OnlyWhileKillAura and OnlyWhileHoldingSword gate activation.
liquidbounce.module.offhand.block.extend:
Target: Scaffold/Eagle building support.
Equips valid scaffold blocks in offhand while Scaffold or Eagle modules are active.
Lowest priority among combat offhand modes.
Ensure building blocks are in inventory before enabling.
liquidbounce.module.chestStealer.selecti:
Target: Human-like steal order by slot proximity.
Sorts container slots by distance from a start item (Default, Random, MaxSlot, or MinSlot) with optional RandomFactor jitter.
Mimics natural mouse paths across chest GUIs.
Pairs with InventoryCleaner plan when that module runs.

Target: Predictable slot-order stealing.
Sorts items by container slot index ascending or descending before scheduling pickups.
Fastest deterministic order — easier for AC pattern detection than Distance.
Use Ascending for top-left to bottom-right looting.

Target: Unpredictable loot order.
Shuffles the useful-item list each tick before moving items.
Reduces repetitive patterns on servers logging steal sequences.
Slower than Index for full clears.
liquidbounce.module.chestStealer.aura.ex:
Target: Hands-free chest looting.
Rotates to and opens nearby storage blocks (chests, barrels, shulkers, furnaces, etc.) within Range/WallRange, then ChestStealer handles contents.
NotDuringCombat pauses targeting; PauseOn conditions skip during combat or item use.
TrackManualInteractions remembers chests you opened manually.
liquidbounce.module.chestStealer.aura.aw:
Target: Reliable chest open confirmation.
After right-clicking storage, waits up to Timeout ticks for the container screen; retries up to MaxRetries if it fails.
Prevents marking chests looted before GUI opens.
Disable on instant-open servers to steal faster.
liquidbounce.module.chestStealer.silentS:
Target: Steal without visible chest GUI.
Hides the container screen client-side while ChestStealer still processes slots; UnlockCursor frees mouse movement.
DrawInventoryTag can render item preview at the chest world position.
Server still sees you in a container — not true silent to anti-cheat.

Target: World-space loot preview during silent steal.
Renders container item icons (and optional title) floating at the interacted block with Scale and RenderOffset.
Requires SilentScreen enabled and a tracked last interacted block.
Excluded from published configs (doNotIncludeAlways).
liquidbounce.module.autoQueue.presets.hy:
Target: Hypixel SkyWars queues.
When paper is in hotbar and pause conditions are clear, sends /play solo_normal or solo_insane based on GameMode every 20 ticks.
Requires Hypixel lobby paper item meta — no chat parsing.
Pause when ClickGUI, chat, containers, or pause menu is open.
liquidbounce.module.autoQueue.presets.go:
Target: GommeHD.net Duels (German client language recommended).
Detects lobby vs duels from tab header, interacts with Duels NPC in lobby, uses player head to queue in duels, sends GG chat on win/loss.
ControlKillAura disables KillAura while queueing and re-enables in match.
Requires German tab/chat strings — wrong language breaks detection.
liquidbounce.module.autoQueue.presets.cu:
Target: User-defined queue automation on any server.
When the selected Trigger fires, runs the selected Action (chat command or use item); optional WaitUntilWorldChange delays re-trigger until dimension/world changes.
Control sub-toggle manages KillAura/Speed during queue state.
Configure trigger text, items, or tab headers in nested trigger/action modes.

Target: Module coordination during custom auto-queue.
When wasInQueue is true, disables KillAura and/or Speed per toggles; re-enables when queue state clears.
Prevents combat modules interfering with lobby queue actions.
Only applies while Custom preset is active.

Target: Title or subtitle overlay text matching.
Triggers when the in-game title or subtitle string contains your configured keywords (Title and Subtitle trigger modes share this setting name in code).
Use for minigame victory, game over, or countdown overlays.
Case-sensitive match depends on server formatting codes.

Target: Chat game message matching.
Triggers on ChatReceiveEvent when message text contains your filter string.
Supports regex-style setup in trigger settings for lobby announcements.
Ignores non-game chat types depending on trigger implementation.

Target: Hotbar item presence or change triggers.
Fires when configured item conditions match — commonly paper/compass queue items in hotbar.
Use for servers that give queue items instead of chat prompts.
Check trigger slot and item filters in settings.

Target: Tab list header text matching.
Triggers when the player list header contains your substring (lobby name, game state, etc.).
Same pause rules as other AutoQueue presets.
Updates every tick while tab is visible.

Target: Tab list footer text matching.
Triggers on footer string match — some networks put queue status in the footer.
Combine with Action chat to run join commands.
Sensitive to server RGB/formatting in footer text.

Target: Command or chat requeue.
Sends configured chat text (e.g. /play ...) when the trigger fires.
Respects AutoQueue pause conditions and Custom wait-for-world-change delay.
Ensure command syntax matches the target server.

Target: Right-click queue items.
Uses the configured hotbar item (paper, compass, etc.) when triggered — mimics manual queue item clicks.
Works with SilentHotbar selection in preset settings.
Item must be present and usable in current GUI state.
liquidbounce.module.blink.autoReset.exte:
Target: Long blink sessions without manual toggle.
After ResetAfter ticks, either cancels queued packets (Reset) or flushes them (Blink) and optionally disables the module if AutoDisable is on.
Dummy player position updates on Blink reset action.
Prevents infinite packet buildup and timeout kicks.
liquidbounce.module.noRotateSet.mode.sil:
Target: Servers forcing rotation via position look packets.
Accepts server rotation silently without visibly snapping your camera — default no-rotate behavior.
No extra settings in this mode.
Use when you only need to ignore set-look packets.
liquidbounce.module.noRotateSet.mode.res:
Target: Restore view after server rotation forces.
Accepts silently but applies RotationsValueGroup to smoothly return aim to your chosen angles after the server sets rotation.
Configure rotation speed and limits in nested rotation settings.
Pairs with KillAura when servers force look at hit.
liquidbounce.module.killAura.autoBlockin:
Automatically blocks with sword or shield between KillAura attacks.
BlockMode Basic sends use-item packets; Interact raycasts blocks or entities first; Fake only plays the block animation client-side.
PrioritizeBlocking delays attacks until you block when in danger. Blink queues outgoing packets while blocking.
UnblockMode controls how blocking stops before a hit. AssumeShield helps on 1.8 servers when offhand shield is simulated.
liquidbounce.module.killAura.velocityHit:
Extends KillAura interaction range briefly after you receive knockback.
Arms when incoming damage is followed by a velocity packet and optional lag is detected (Blink or high packet delay).
OnlyWhileLagging limits the boost to lagging connections. Resets after a few ticks on ground.
Pairs with extended interaction range — use conservative ExtendRange on strict anti-cheats.
liquidbounce.module.killAura.failSwing.e:
Swings at nearby enemies when KillAura cannot reach or has no target, simulating missed attacks.
Uses a randomized AdditionalRange beyond normal reach. Requires empty crosshair (MISS raycast) and attack cooldown readiness.
NotifyWhenFail sub-choice shows Box markers or plays Sound on failed swings.
Can lower effective CPS because miss-time may apply on empty swings.
liquidbounce.module.killAura.failSwing.n:
Disables FailSwing failure notifications.
Fake swings still occur when enabled; only visual and audio feedback is off.

Draws fading boxes where a FailSwing missed the target.
Fade duration is configurable in seconds. Optional rainbow color.
Useful for tuning reach and raycast without chat spam.

Plays a click sound when FailSwing triggers a fake miss.
Volume and pitch are adjustable.
Audible feedback only — no world markers.
liquidbounce.module.fightBot.extendedDes:
FightBot owns autonomous target selection and movement; KillAura remains the attack scheduler.
Nearest selects the strictly closest eligible living entity by default while retaining friend, team, AntiBot, self, liveness, FOV, hurt-time, range, visibility, and void filters. Named preserves legacy SparringOpponent behavior without a fallback target.
AutoEnableKillAura temporarily enables KillAura only when it was previously disabled. Manually disabling KillAura stops the current FightBot session without repeatedly enabling it again.
Normal KillAura melee has priority within standard reach. Beyond that reach, DelegateKillAuraAttacks may hand the target to enabled MaceKill or SpearKill according to the usable held weapon; without one, MaceKill precedes SpearKill, followed by SuperHit. None is enabled automatically. MaceAutomation defaults to Off. Each HeldOrHotbar policy restores FightBot-controlled item use and silent slot selection after completion, rejection, target loss, disable, death, disconnect, or world change.
liquidbounce.module.killAura.rangeIndica:
Renders ground circles for KillAura attack, wall, scan, and opponent ranges.
ColorMode Static, Rainbow, or Distance-based; pulse and fade animations optional.
RespectInventorySetting hides the indicator when inventory handling would pause KillAura.
Syncs with KillAura range settings — useful for tuning reach visually.
liquidbounce.module.backtrack.pauseOnHur:
Pauses backtrack lag while the target's hurtTime is at or above the configured value.
Prevents attacking a target that is still in i-frames from your previous hit.
Only applies when this sub-option is enabled.
liquidbounce.module.backtrack.esp.box.ex:
Draws a colored box at the lagged entity position while Backtrack is active.
Shows where the server still thinks the enemy is versus their real position.
Customize fill and outline colors.
Renders a full entity model at the backtracked position.
Optional nametag override and outline. LightPercent adjusts brightness.
Clearer than a box for judging hit timing on lagged targets.
liquidbounce.module.backtrack.esp.wirefr:
Draws a wireframe player outline at the tracked lag position.
Lightweight ESP style for backtrack visualization.
Good when model ESP is too heavy or cluttered.
liquidbounce.module.backtrack.esp.none.e:
Disables Backtrack ESP visualization.
Lag logic still runs; only the render overlay is off.
liquidbounce.module.autoArmor.hotbar.ext:
Allows equipping armor directly from hotbar slots via use-item clicks.
Faster than inventory shift-clicks when a piece is already on the hotbar.
CanSwapArmor enables 1.19.4+ armor swap mechanics when replacing worn pieces.
Opens your inventory automatically to replace armor before pieces break.
Triggers when durability falls below DurabilityThreshold and no hotbar replacement exists.
Requires inventory constraints that need an open screen; closes inventory after swap.
Closes container screens if armor is lost while in chests to resync armor slots.
Target: Generic sprint-reset knockback boost.
Sends stop/start sprint packets around each qualifying attack to maximize knockback on 1.9+.
Skips when Criticals would deal a critical hit. Respects HurtTime, Chance, and Conditions filters.
Blatant packet spam — disable on servers that validate sprint state strictly.

Target: Legit-style sprint tap after attacks.
Temporarily cancels sprint via SprintEvent until you stop sprinting, waits ReSprint ticks, then allows sprint again.
More human-like than Packet mode but slower to re-sprint.
Only runs when OnlyOnMove and condition filters pass.

Target: Classic W-tap movement knockback.
After a hit, waits UntilMovementBlock ticks, clears forward input until you release W, then waits UntilAllowedMovement.
Resets enemy sprint collision knockback similar to manual W-tapping.
Requires forward movement; OnlyForward limits sideways-only strafe taps.
liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.onlyO:
Requires movement input before SuperKnockback activates.
OnlyForward ignores pure strafe without forward key.
Prevents sprint-reset KB while standing still.
liquidbounce.module.tpAura.mode.aStar.ex:
Pathfinds to the nearest target with A*, then teleports along the path in chunks.
Rewrites outgoing move packets to the desync position; wireframe shows server-side ghost.
TpBack returns to start after Stick ticks. Setback packets cancel the path.
High packet volume — expect flags outside permissive or lag-based AC environments.
liquidbounce.module.tpAura.mode.immediat:
Teleports directly to the closest target on click ticks, waits, then returns.
Splits long distances into 10-block move packet steps.
Simpler than AStar but ignores walls and obstacles.
Server setbacks clear desync and show an error message.
liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.i:
Smoothly interpolates view angles toward the target using configurable horizontal and vertical speed ranges.
DirectionChangeFactor scales smoothing when the aim direction changes sharply.
Default gentle assist suitable for most servers; tune speeds for snappier or slower aim.
liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.s:
Uses a sigmoid curve for angle smoothing — slower near the target, faster when far off.
Factor-based smoothing shared with other combat rotation modules.
Can look more natural than linear interpolation at close angles.
liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.l:
Applies constant-rate linear smoothing toward the target rotation.
Predictable, uniform turn speed each tick.
Easier to tune but may look robotic compared to Interpolation or Sigmoid.
liquidbounce.module.elytraTarget.autoFir:
Automatically uses firework rockets while elytra targeting an enemy.
UseMode Normal uses hotbar/offhand swap; Packet sends use-item without full client use animation.
SyncCooldownWithKillAura delays fireworks until KillAura is ready to hit at extended range.
Cooldown shortens when the target is within ExtraDistance.
liquidbounce.module.elytraTarget.rotatio:
Predicts target position ahead while computing ElytraTarget rotations.
Simple extrapolates velocity; WithGravity subtracts gravity over the multiplier window.
GlidingOnly skips prediction when the target is not elytra flying.
Improves lead on fast-moving elytra enemies.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.place.ex:
Automatically places end crystals on valid obsidian or bedrock bases.
Switch mode controls silent hotbar selection; Delay and range or wall range gate placements.
Old 1_12_2 placement rules, sequenced packets, jitter, and placement renderer are optional.
Core submodule — disable only if you want manual placement.
Breaks end crystals in range after placement or when triggers fire.
Respects Delay, range, walls range, and swing mode. PrioritizeVisibleFaces prefers exposed crystal faces.
Feeds post-attack handlers like SetDead and speed debugger.
Requires line-of-sight or wall range for each break attempt.
Removes attacked crystals client-side immediately instead of waiting for the entity remove packet.
ConfirmTime re-spawns the crystal if no remove packet arrives — prevents ghost desync.
Allows faster follow-up placements on high CPS crystal aura profiles.
Wrong confirmations may briefly show crystals again.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.basePlac:
Builds obsidian or bedrock bases under enemies when no valid crystal spot exists.
PlatformOnly, OnlyAboveSelf, and Terrain filters control where bases may go. MinAdvantage requires damage gain.
Uses BlockPlacer with calc delay and timeout. SimulateMovement avoids trapping yourself.
CPU-heavy on rough terrain — increase CalcDelay if laggy.

Simulates your movement for several ticks before approving a base place position.
Growing error box per tick prevents placing where you will walk. AntiPlatformSimulate avoids helping enemies on your Y level.
Disable only if you accept running into your own base blocks.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.iDPredic:
Predicts the next entity ID and sends attack packets immediately after placing a crystal.
OffsetRange tries multiple IDs around the highest seen entity ID. Rotate sends aim packets toward the crystal.
SwingAlways swings each predict attack. Wrong ID offsets hit nothing or wrong entities.
High-risk on servers with strict attack order checks.

Sends rotation packets toward the predicted crystal before ID-predict attacks.
Back restores your previous rotation after attacking.
Required on servers that validate look direction on break packets.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.self.ext:
Simulates your future position for crystal damage and blockage checks.
PlaceTicks, BreakTicks, and BasePlaceTicks offset simulation time per action type.
CalculationMode chooses current, predicted, or combined damage. CheckIntersect skips blocked placements.
Tune tick counts to match your place and break speed.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.self.cal:
Uses both current and predicted self positions for damage calculations.
Logic And requires both to pass thresholds; Or accepts if either passes.
Safer than PredictOnly when simulation is imperfect.

Damage and placement checks use only your simulated future position.
Ignores where you stand now — aggressive for moving fights.
May skip safe placements if simulation error is high.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.target.e:
Simulates the enemy's future position for crystal damage and intersection checks.
Same tick offsets as Self predict but applied to the target player.
Helps lead moving targets in crystal DPS calculations.
Inaccurate on teleports or knockback spikes.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.target.c:
Combines current and predicted target damage with And or Or logic.
And is conservative; Or finds more placements when either snapshot deals enough damage.
Match Logic to your risk tolerance.

Evaluates damage only at the target's predicted position.
Better for strafing enemies; may overestimate if they change direction.
Pair with reasonable BreakTicks and PlaceTicks.
liquidbounce.module.crystalAura.rotation:
Aims at crystal place and break points using standard rotation manager smoothing.
PostMove and Instant options match other combat modules. IgnoreOpenInventory allows aiming with GUI open.
Nested RotationsValueGroup controls speed, reset, and movement correction.
Recommended default for most crystal aura setups.

Skips client rotation assistance for crystal actions.
Optional SendRotationPacket still sends one-off aim packets when enabled.
Use when you aim manually or an anti-cheat flags rotation snaps.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.box.extende:
Draws 3D filled boxes around entities in world space.
Optional outline and MergeIntersecting combines overlapping boxes for cleaner visuals.
Expand inflates box size. Colors come from the active ColorMode.
Works without TrueSight unlike Glow mode.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.2D.extended:
Projects 2D screen-space boxes around entities with optional fill, outline, corners, border, and health bar.
Corner mode draws bracket-style edges; HealthBar shows remaining HP beside the box.
Nested Outline, Corner, Border, and HealthBar toggles customize layers.
Classic ESP look; scales with camera distance via MaximumDistance.
Draws the outer rectangular outline of 2D ESP boxes.
Thickness controls line width in pixels.
Disable for fill-only boxes.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.2D.corner.e:
Replaces full outlines with corner brackets on 2D ESP.
Gap percent controls how much of each edge is drawn.
Popular minimal ESP style.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.2D.border.e:
Adds an extra border layer outside the 2D ESP box.
Thickness sets border width.
Improves contrast on busy backgrounds.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.2D.healthBa:
Shows a vertical health bar next to 2D ESP boxes.
Spacing offsets the bar from the box edge.
Color reflects current HP via entity health.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.legacy2D.ex:
Renders old-style 3D markers above entities using legacy 2D marker draw calls.
Scale and YOffset adjust marker size and height. BackgroundAlpha tints the marker backdrop.
Lightweight retro ESP distinct from modern 2D projection.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.outline.ext:
Draws a crisp custom shader outline around target silhouettes.
Thickness and Opacity customize the edge while the two-pixel, fully opaque look remains the default.
When ESP and StorageESP use Outline together, the stronger value for each shared-mask setting wins.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.outline.thi: Width of the shader outline in framebuffer pixels.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.outline.opa: Opacity multiplier for the complete outline.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.extend:
Renders a classic shader Glow ESP with a bright core and a halo that fades naturally outward.
Radius, Softness, Intensity, CoreSize, and Opacity are adjustable; the original 14-pixel 2020-style look remains the default.
When ESP and StorageESP use Glow together, the stronger value for each shared-mask setting wins.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.radius: How far the soft halo spreads in framebuffer pixels.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.softne: Controls whether the Gaussian fade is tighter or more gradual.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.intens: Brightness of the soft halo relative to the sharp core.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.coreSi: Width of the bright inner edge; zero disables the core.
liquidbounce.module.esp.mode.glow.opacit: Opacity multiplier for both the halo and its bright core.
liquidbounce.module.esp.colorMode.distan:
Colors ESP by distance using an HSB curve.
